LanguageData.Apparel_Poncho.label: poncho
LanguageData.Apparel_Poncho.description: A well-known sleeveless garment with unsewn sides and a space for the head to pass through. Design to keep warmth and protect the body from harsh weather conditions while still having the freedom of movement to continue working comfortably.
LanguageData.Apparel_Sombrero.label: sombrero
LanguageData.Apparel_Sombrero.description: Broad-brimmed, high-crowned hat made of felt or straw. Its name derived from the Spanish word sombra, meaning “shade,” first appeared in the 15th century.
